name: Dev Tools
description: 26 everyday developer utilities in a package under 100KB — generators (password/QR/barcode/ID/lorem), codecs (Base64/URL/escape/image), crypto (hash/HMAC/JWT/AES), text tools (JSON/diff/case/lines/mojibake) and more. Pure frontend, zero permissions.
releaseNotes: 26 tools: password/ID/lorem/QR/barcode generators, Base64/URL/escape/image codecs, hash & HMAC, JWT decode & sign, AES, RMB uppercase, JSON formatter, text diff, case/line/invisible-char/mojibake tools, timestamp & date calc, file size, number base, color & contrast, chmod.

zh-CN.name: Dev Tools
zh-CN.description: 26 个日常开发工具，安装包不到 100KB——生成器（密码/二维码/条码/ID/占位文本）、编解码（Base64/URL/转义/图片）、安全（哈希/HMAC/JWT/AES）、文本工具（JSON/对比/大小写/行处理/乱码修复）等。纯前端、零权限。
